explanation: h(n) (cofactorThreshold) is the largest m such that every n-element A ⊆ ℕ has at least m distinct values a/(a,b), as on erdosproblems.com/539. Allowing 0 ∈ A changes counts by O(1) at most, which is irrelevant here. Since ProofCouncil showed h(n) ≤ e^{O(√log n)}n^{1/2} = n^{1/2+o(1)}, h(n) is not Θ(n^{2/3}). The statement asserts this negation. Faithful.
